title: MiniMax publishes an official MiniMax H3 blog entry
summary: On 2026-07-31, MiniMax published an official blog entry associated with MiniMax H3. The dated link establishes a public project communication, but the sealed evidence does not establish the specific product change, capabilities, or availability described there.
research_notes: MiniMax launched H3 with multimodal context and native-stereo video up to 2K/15 seconds; weights were promised for a later release.
